prompt: Assess this claim: Indigenous people have been enslaved at some point in history.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
The claim is **true**. Indigenous peoples have been enslaved in multiple regions and historical periods.

For example, European colonizers enslaved Indigenous people in the Americas, including in the Caribbean, Brazil, and parts of North America. Some Indigenous societies also practiced forms of slavery before European colonization.

The claim establishes that this happened; it does not imply that all Indigenous peoples experienced slavery or that its forms were identical across societies.
